profile.name: PTCRIS Data Governance Profile
profile.description: Current profile migrated from the legacy constraints workbook. Constraints are reusable RSR artefacts; this profile selects/configures them.
profile.notes: Future profile versions should normally set base_profile_id and record only changed target settings/defaults/overrides.

PRESENCE.description: Presence behaviour is resolved from the Validation Target requirement level; presence is not included in the reference score.

REGEX.description: Default for regular-expression and format constraints.

RESOLVABLE.description: Default for resolver constraints; non-blocking by default to remain compatible with the current PT Master runtime behaviour.
